## Cold open

> SCENE (states): Brandenburg lights up on the map of Germany.
> Brandenburg | Landeshauptstadt Potsdam

[dramatic] [[Brandenburg]] surrounds Berlin on every side. Its capital is Potsdam, with the palace of Sanssouci, just outside Berlin. Until 1990 it was part of the DDR.

[dramatic] If you take the citizenship test in Brandenburg, three of your thirty-three questions are about the state you live in. They come from a list of just ten. Here are all ten, with the answers.

> SCENE (title): Title card.
> BRANDENBURG

## On the map

{Q338}

> SCENE (question): Question card #338. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows a map with four states, numbered. [[Welches Bundesland ist Brandenburg?]] Which state is Brandenburg?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[4]]. Number four: the large state around Berlin, in the east.


{Q337}

> SCENE (question): Question card #337. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Die Landeshauptstadt von Brandenburg heißt …]] The state capital of Brandenburg is...

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Potsdam.]] The other three are real cities in Brandenburg, but not the capital.


## Flag and coat of arms

{Q335}

> SCENE (question): Question card #335. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welche Farben hat die Landesflagge von Brandenburg?]] What are the colors of the state flag of Brandenburg?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[rot-weiß]]. Red and white, with the red eagle.


{Q331}

> SCENE (question): Question card #331. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows four coats of arms. [[Welches Wappen gehört zum Bundesland Brandenburg?]] Which coat of arms belongs to the state of Brandenburg?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Bild 1]], picture one: a red eagle on a white shield.


## How it's run

{Q332}

> SCENE (question): Question card #332. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welches ist ein Landkreis in Brandenburg?]] Which of these is a district in Brandenburg?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Prignitz]]. The others are elsewhere: [[Rhein-Sieg-Kreis]] is in [[Nordrhein-Westfalen]], [[Vogtlandkreis]] is in [[Sachsen]], and [[Amberg-Sulzbach]] is in [[Bayern]].


{Q333}

> SCENE (question): Question card #333. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Für wie viele Jahre wird der Landtag in Brandenburg gewählt?]] For how many years is the state parliament in Brandenburg elected?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[5]]. Five years, like almost every state parliament.


{Q334}

> SCENE (question): Question card #334. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Ab welchem Alter darf man in Brandenburg bei Kommunalwahlen wählen?]] From what age are you allowed to vote in local elections in Brandenburg?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[16]]. Here, you can vote in local elections from sixteen. It differs from state to state. For the Bundestag, it's eighteen everywhere.


{Q339}

> SCENE (question): Question card #339. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] [[Wie nennt man die Regierungschefin oder den Regierungschef in Brandenburg?]] What is the head of government in Brandenburg called?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident]], the minister-president. Not a prime minister, and not a mayor: mayors run towns and cities.


{Q340}

> SCENE (question): Question card #340. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Außenministerin oder Außenminister

[dramatic] And a question with a [[nicht]]. [[Welche Ministerin oder welchen Minister hat Brandenburg nicht?]] Which minister does Brandenburg not have?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Außenministerin oder Außenminister]], a foreign minister. Foreign policy is the federation's job, so no state has one. Finance, justice and the interior: every state has those.


{Q336}

> SCENE (question): Question card #336. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Wo können Sie sich in Brandenburg über politische Themen informieren?]] Where can you find information on political topics in Brandenburg?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[bei der Landeszentrale für politische Bildung]], the state centre for civic education. Every state has one. It's free, it belongs to no party, and it has material on politics in plain language.


## What to remember for the exam

> SCENE (words): The words appear one by one, then settle into a grid.
> Potsdam, rot-weiß, Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] Three answers to hold on to: [[Potsdam]]. [[rot-weiß]]. And [[Ministerpräsident]].
